messages:
Lina: quick 15-min design check: updated mini-map scrub for deployments. need a11y review and copy for canary tooltip.
Noah: looks good, one worry: when using keyboard to scrub the mini-map, SRs read percentage only. should prepend 'Version' and id.
Ava: agree. propose announce pattern: 'Version vX.Y.Z — deployed 45 minutes ago — live — actions: promote, rollback'. debounce updates to 120ms.
Diego: implementation note: keep live region outside canvas and update text node only; canvas redraws shouldn't trigger AT noise.
Sam: rollback affordance: suggest hidden emergency 'panic rollback' accessible via keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+R) for SREs. must confirm via modal.
Lina: shortcut is fine for SREs, but modal must be focus-trapped and read purpose. copy for modal heading: 'Confirm emergency rollback'. body: 'This will route traffic back to the previous version. Proceed?'
Ava: tweak: change button text to 'Rollback to previous version' and cancel to 'Keep current'. give confirm an aria-describedby with undo window: 'You can undo within 5 minutes.'
Noah: UI placement: move rollback out of primary toolbar and into a danger-styled overflow menu to avoid accidental clicks.
Diego: filed PERF-1298 for throttling canvas redraws on scrub.
DeployBot: preview build deployed by Lina — https://staging.redwood.internal/mini-map/2041300123
Lina: thanks team, I'll update Figma and tag @Ava @Diego @Sam for follow-ups.
Ava: I'll run SR passes tomorrow and post a checklist.
